import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import signal
import socket
import subprocess
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
candidate = json.loads((root/'artifacts/fanout-view-candidate.json').read_text())
binary = root/candidate['directory']/'war-relay'
report_path = root/'docs/benchmarks/2026-10-16-fanout-view-api.json'
def port():
    with socket.socket() as s:
        s.bind(('127.0.0.1',0))
        return s.getsockname()[1]
relay_port, admin_port = port(), port()
assert relay_port != admin_port
env = {k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('WAR_')}
env.update(WAR_ADMIN_TOKEN='disposable-local-acceptance',
           ADMIN_URL=f'http://127.0.0.1:{admin_port}',
           RELAY_URL=f'ws://127.0.0.1:{relay_port}',
           PAGING_ACCEPT_OUTPUT=str(report_path))
command = [str(binary),'--workers','4','--bind',f'127.0.0.1:{relay_port}',
           '--admin-bind',f'127.0.0.1:{admin_port}']
log_path = root/'artifacts/fanout-view-api-server.log'
transitions = []
def control(method,path,expected,authorized=True):
    headers={'Authorization':'Bearer disposable-local-acceptance'} if authorized else {}
    request=urllib.request.Request(env['ADMIN_URL']+path, method=method, headers=headers)
    try:
        response=urllib.request.urlopen(request,timeout=3)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
        response=error
    with response:
        body=response.read().decode(); status=response.status
    assert status==expected, (method,path,status,body)
    transitions.append({'method':method,'path':path,'authorized':authorized,'status':status})
    return body
with log_path.open('wb') as log:
    server = subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=root,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=log)
    try:
        deadline = time.monotonic()+5
        while True:
            assert server.poll() is None
            try:
                with urllib.request.urlopen(env['ADMIN_URL']+'/readyz',timeout=1) as response:
                    assert response.status == 200
                break
            except OSError:
                assert time.monotonic() < deadline
                time.sleep(.02)
        subprocess.run(['node','artifacts/paging-accept.mjs'],cwd=root,env=env,check=True,timeout=30)
        control('POST','/v1/drain',401,False)
        control('POST','/v1/drain',204)
        control('GET','/healthz',200,False)
        control('GET','/readyz',503,False)
        assert 'war_draining 1\n' in control('GET','/metrics',200)
        control('POST','/v1/resume',401,False)
        control('POST','/v1/resume',204)
        control('GET','/readyz',200,False)
    finally:
        if server.poll() is None: server.send_signal(signal.SIGINT)
        exit_code = server.wait(timeout=5)
assert exit_code == 0
report = json.loads(report_path.read_text())
assert report['passed'] and len(report['checks']) == 4
report.update(manual_admission_transitions=transitions,server_sha256=hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              server_exit_code=exit_code,server_command=command,
              server_log=log_path.read_text(),
              client_source=(root/'artifacts/paging-accept.mjs').read_text(),
              runner_source=Path(__file__).read_text())
assert report['server_sha256'] == candidate['binaries']['war-relay']
report_path.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'passed':True,'checks':len(report['checks']),'normal_closes':13,'server_exit':exit_code}))
